$comment: Ratchet baseline for `astro check --minimumSeverity error`. This number may only go DOWN. tests/typecheck-baseline.typecheck.ts fails if it rises (a regression) and also fails if it drops (so the baseline is retightened rather than quietly leaving slack). Run `pnpm test:types` to check, then lower `total` to the reported count.

notes.concentration: src/pages/theleague/rosters.astro still dominates this number. The split plan in docs/plans/rosters-page-split.md is the route down: each extracted module takes its errors with it, because an exported function needs a signature. Verify the inline script via @astrojs/compiler transform + esbuild parse, NOT a full astro check (see docs/claude/insights/features/august-roster-cuts.md).
notes.composition: The bulk is implicit-any annotation debt (ts7006/7005/7053) plus property-access noise (ts2339), not defects. The null-safety class outside rosters.astro is at zero and should stay there.

notes.clearedClasses: These classes were driven to zero and are pinned there separately, because the total alone cannot protect them: an improvement elsewhere can mask a regression in one of these and still leave the total lower, which the ratchet would read as progress.
